entities.name: Query protein Shu2
observations: 251 aa protein; exact sequence match to reviewed Kluyveromyces lactis Suppressor of hydroxyurea sensitivity protein 2 (UniProt B4UNA2).
Predicted molecular weight 28.47 kDa, theoretical pI 5.12, and net charge approximately -11.7 at pH 7.
Contains a Pfam SHU2 domain (PF29629.1) spanning residues 12–246.
Homologous reviewed fungal Shu2 proteins are nuclear and participate in RAD51/RAD54-dependent homologous recombination repair.

entities.name: Kluyveromyces lactis Shu2
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein B4UNA2; exact sequence and full-length match to the query.
Functions in a RAD51/RAD54-dependent homologous recombination repair pathway during S phase, supporting error-free repair of spontaneous and induced DNA lesions.

entities.name: Shu complex
observations: Fungal Shu2 homologs are annotated as components of the Shu complex involved in DNA repair and DNA recombinase assembly.

entities.name: Homologous recombination repair
observations: Reviewed fungal Shu2 annotations place the protein in RAD51/RAD54-dependent homologous recombination repair of MMS-induced lesions during S phase.
